description: Plan and deliver browser games from a brief; choose scope, engine, milestones, and release gates.
Implement and tune deterministic game loops, movement, cameras, combat, collisions, and progression.
Design cohesive 3D browser-game rendering, lighting, materials, cameras, and effects.
Build responsive game menus, HUDs, controls, loading states, and accessible feedback.
Prepare and integrate game models, textures, sprites, animation, audio, and asset manifests.
Profile browser games and fix frame pacing, loading, memory growth, and input latency.
Playtest and release browser games with reproducible functional, visual, performance and build checks.
Efficiently inspect, implement, verify and hand off coding tasks while preserving user scope.
Build sprite-based browser games with Phaser scenes, physics, cameras, input and restart-safe lifecycle.
